title: Étale restriction of coefficient duals
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $U\to X$ an étale morphism, and $F$ any sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small étale site of $X$. Let $\Lambda_X$ and $\Lambda_U$ denote the constant coefficient sheaves [def-constructible-constant], equivalently the monoidal units. Then $(F^\vee)|_U\cong (F|_U)^\vee$, where $F^\vee=\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$ and restriction means étale inverse image.

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-etale-pullback-internal-hom to the etale morphism U.hom and the pair (F, the monoidal unit), obtaining an isomorphism from restriction of the coefficient dual to internalHom of the restricted F into the restricted unit. In Lean, obtain its witness with nonempty_etale_upperStar_ihom_iso U.hom F (𝟙_ _).

The proved strong monoidal structure Etale.monoidal_upperStar supplies Functor.Monoidal.εIso, whose inverse identifies the restricted unit with the unit on U. Apply the functor ihom of the restricted F to this inverse isomorphism with mapIso, compose with the previous isomorphism, and introduce Nonempty. This is the two-line isomorphism composition in the Lean proof.

proof_origin.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit local internal Hom argument; specialize the existing general comparison and compose with Functor.Monoidal.εIso from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.UpperLowerStar.Monoidal

theorem nonempty_etaleDualRestrictionIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.hom).obj
      ((ihom F).obj (𝟙_ _)) ≅
      (ihom ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.hom).obj F)).obj (𝟙_ _))
